title: Theorem 7.4.5: a minimizing cone in a closed half-space lies in the boundary hyperplane
statement: Let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) be minimizing in ℝ^{n+k}, ∂C = 0, and a cone (η_{0,λ#}C = C for all λ > 0). If v ≠ 0 and spt C ⊆ closure{x : ⟨v,x⟩ > 0}, then spt C ⊆ frontier{x : ⟨v,x⟩ > 0} = {x : ⟨v,x⟩ = 0}.
